preferredStorage: puzzles/{language}/{category}.json plus optional numbered shards such as {category}-2.json
notes: Category files are loaded on demand. All five supported languages now provide 10 puzzles in each of the 10 categories, for 100 ready-made crosswords per language and 500 total. The loader automatically merges numbered shards, allowing the library to grow without increasing the initial page payload. Older per-language library files remain available as a compatibility fallback.
